title: Joe Rogan Experience #2479 - Bob Lazar & Luigi Vendittelli
rawDescription: Bob Lazar made headlines in 1989 during an anonymous interview with journalist George Knapp, where he described working with extraterrestrial technology at a site near Area 51. He is the subject of the documentary directed Luigi Vendittelli “S4: The Bob Lazar Story,” now streaming on Amazon Prime Video.
